prompt_registry_ref.description: Ref to prompt template registry (apps_rg owned).
prompt_registry_ref.title: Prompt Registry Ref

replay_key.description: Deterministic replay key — required, never empty.
replay_key.title: Replay Key

ResumePayloadSection.description: Source resume payload — at least one of text or ref required (validated above).

RuntimeCustomizationPackage.description:
Complete runtime operating package for apps_rg.

Carries declarative refs, digests, policies, and gate/judge/eval metadata
that downstream core stages consume. U0 validates and preserves this section
verbatim under app_payload — U0 does NOT execute any of these references.

Wave 2.5 (apps-rg-ensemble-judge-restoration-a7c4e2): blocking precondition
for Wave 3 (L3 workflow runner) and Wave 4 (L2 ENSEMBLE_MODEL lane).

conditional_exit_gates.description: Gate IDs conditionally invoked at Exit (based on output_requirements).
conditional_exit_gates.title: Conditional Exit Gates

eval_rubric_ref.description: Ref to evaluation rubric for quality scoring.
eval_rubric_ref.title: Eval Rubric Ref

grader_roster_ref.description: Ref to grader roster (which providers grade which sections).
grader_roster_ref.title: Grader Roster Ref

judge_profile_ref.description: Ref to judge jury profile (provider roster + rubric binding).
judge_profile_ref.title: Judge Profile Ref

learning_profile_ref.description: Ref to learning profile (L6 RuntimeExhaustBundle consumption).
learning_profile_ref.title: Learning Profile Ref

negative_controls_ref.description: Ref to negative control definitions for judge calibration.
negative_controls_ref.title: Negative Controls Ref

orchestration_profile_ref.description: Ref to orchestration profile (L3 merge/split strategy).
orchestration_profile_ref.title: Orchestration Profile Ref

package_digest.description: SHA-256 over canonical JSON of this section (integrity seal).
package_digest.title: Package Digest

prompt_profile_ref.description: Ref to prompt profile (PA template selection).
prompt_profile_ref.title: Prompt Profile Ref

provider_profile_ref.description: Ref to provider profile (model/judge provider roster).
provider_profile_ref.title: Provider Profile Ref

required_exit_gates.description: Gate IDs that MUST pass at Exit (G21-G28).
required_exit_gates.title: Required Exit Gates

required_runtime_gates.description: Gate IDs that MUST pass before L2 execution.
required_runtime_gates.title: Required Runtime Gates

retrieval_profile_ref.description: Ref to retrieval profile (C0 grounding strategy).
retrieval_profile_ref.title: Retrieval Profile Ref

route_profile_ref.description: Ref to route profile (L0 routing hints).
route_profile_ref.title: Route Profile Ref

rubric_output_map_ref.description: Ref to rubric-output mapping (rubric → output format).
rubric_output_map_ref.title: Rubric Output Map Ref

runtime_gate_profile_ref.description: Ref to runtime gate profile (pre-L2 gates).
runtime_gate_profile_ref.title: Runtime Gate Profile Ref

threshold_profile_ref.description: Ref to threshold profile for gate pass/fail.
threshold_profile_ref.title: Threshold Profile Ref

workflow_manifest_ref.description: Ref to managed workflow manifest. Empty → single_step.
workflow_manifest_ref.title: Workflow Manifest Ref

write_policy.description: Write policy: 'read_only' | 'deferred_writeback'. apps_rg is always read_only.
write_policy.title: Write Policy

tenant_id.description: Tenant id (= app_id at this layer).
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id

description:
The canonical apps_rg JSON ingress payload, version 1.

All sub-sections are required. Optional fields have explicit defaults
documented in the section model. Unknown fields at the top level are
rejected by Pydantic (``extra='forbid'``), and the U0 reflection adapter
additionally verifies that every JSON Pointer in the input has a matching
field-map entry — catching any field that validates but is silently
dropped.

Capability-requirement clause (Author-Gate AG-4.b): apps_rg declares
semantic needs (``capability_requirements``); core L0's model_registry
maps requirements → provider/model. apps_rg NEVER names a provider here.

apps_rg_contract_version.description: MUST equal 'v1'. Different versions require a different module.
apps_rg_contract_version.title: Apps Rg Contract Version

capability_requirements.description: Per Author-Gate AG-4.b: semantic capability needs (e.g. 'needs_strong_narrative', 'needs_long_context'). apps_rg MAY NOT name a provider; core L0 maps requirements → provider.
capability_requirements.title: Capability Requirements

generation_mode.description: One of the GenerationMode enum values. Unknown values fail closed.

payload_digest.description: SHA-256 over canonical JSON of all sibling fields except payload_digest itself.
payload_digest.title: Payload Digest

runtime_customization_package.description: Complete runtime operating package. Carries all refs/digests/policies downstream core stages need. Default-constructed (all empty) so existing payloads without this section remain valid.

title: AppsRgIngressContractV1
